title: tier-2 shipped code: the collision cell-array fixup against MapChunkCellBytesFixup (0x141ff51a0)

unreachableBranches.why: the header-mode == 0 allocation branch. It allocates a 0x10 header, stores it back, then reads the zeroed first qword as the entry table, so it faults on the first dereference; the shipping loader converts the file's entries before this pass. Every generated case uses a non-zero header mode.
the entry-mode == 0 allocation branch, the same allocate-then-deref-null path as the header mode. The fixture emits entry modes 1 and 2/3 only, which is the runtime form the loader produces.

notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/collision.rs (fixup_cell_bytes), built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the cell_bytes_fixup entry. The ledger binds the verdict to collision.rs + the probe source + the git revision.

Oracle is MapChunkCellBytesFixup at exe 0x141ff51a0 (v2b 0x7ff7c6d151a0). The function is 0x237 bytes in the image's .pdata (0x141ff51a0..0x141ff53d7), and the unit declares that exact coverage window.

The client's argument is one pointer to a {inner header, mode} pair. Mode 1 reads the count from inner+8 and the entry table from inner+0; any other mode reads the count from inner+0 and the entry table from inner+8. Each 0x10-byte entry is {Q, entry_mode}: entry mode 1 stores the record pointer at Q, any other mode stores it at *(Q+8).

The compared channel is the whole 0xC00-byte block. Relative pointers (outer header, inner header field, entry Q, record-pointer slot) are declared relocations and masked; the 17 record qwords written by the function are data and are compared exactly, including a wrapping boundary value.

The probe receives the arena block's base address as a second, candidate-only argument, so the oracle's absolute record addresses and the candidate's are the same numbers; the function still sees one pointer argument, exactly as the client does.

Record qwords are a mix of zero (null after the fixup), ordinary boundaries and a huge wrapping value; the zero case is the empty-array boundary the payload actually carries (dev/data/collision_0688.bin, cell 86).

Branch coverage is 33.3% (1 of 3 reachable sites). The two skipped sites are the JZ after each mode-0 Alloc call; the allocator reads the heap vtable at 0x144188200, which is null in the offline image, so those sites cannot run without a live heap. The loop's both edges and the two declared mode edges are covered.
acknowledgedGaps: Only the non-allocating encodings are verified: header mode 1 and 2/3, entry mode 1 and 2/3. The header-mode-0 and entry-mode-0 allocation branches are declared unreachable (they allocate and then read the zeroed allocation).

The file-to-runtime conversion of the cell entries (cell {block_size, record_off} -> entry {record pointer, 1}) runs before this unit and is not part of it; it is recorded as an observation in docs/formats/domino.md, not verified here.
This unit proves the 17-pointer conversion only. The cell-to-shape decoder, the 0x100-byte sector entries, ShapeAddToBody and the live collision world remain open.

The JZ sites inside the two allocate-then-deref-null blocks (0x7ff7c6d15205 and 0x7ff7c6d15246) never execute offline: Alloc dereferences the process heap vtable at 0x144188200, which is null in the image. They are inside the blocks the two declared dead edges skip.
